entities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), established in 1901 and headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland, serves as the United States' premier measurement standards laboratory. Its inception was driven by the burgeoning needs of the industrial sector in the United States, where the lack of standardized measurements was impeding technological advancement and trade. NIST has played a pivotal role in advancing measurement science, developing standards that underpin a wide range of industries from manufacturing to telecommunications, thus ensuring quality and safety in products and services.

The institute was originally founded as the National Bureau of Standards, reflecting its core mission to establish reliable standards across various domains. Over the decades, it has contributed to the development of measurement techniques, including those for temperature, mass, and time, and has participated in international standards organizations, enhancing global trade networks. Key achievements include the establishment of the atomic clock in 1960, which revolutionized timekeeping and has implications in navigation and telecommunications. NIST also engages in cutting-edge research in fields like quantum information science, furthering the boundaries of technology.

NIST's legacy is evident in its profound influence on both national and international standards, shaping the landscape of modern commerce and science. Its standards have been adopted worldwide, facilitating accurate measurements that are vital for scientific research and industrial production. The establishment of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework in 2014 is a testament to its ongoing evolution and relevance in the face of new challenges posed by the digital age. As of 2023, NIST continues to be a beacon of measurement excellence, with its work impacting trillions of dollars in the global economy and ensuring the safety and reliability of countless products and services.
